searchText: You can use `make` to build the spec after git checkout. Then check `build/lib/eth2spec/electra/mainnet.py`. It should have all the changes reconciled. Given that this question came up also here https://discord.com/channels/694822223575384095/768890674493390909/1384917921318310040 maybe it would be nice if with a git action the latest build output is push somewhere public for easy reference. For the REST API specs, I believe that we do that already from some source of truth.
